recommendations.name: Greptile auto-approve
recommendations.description: Greptile approves a PR only on a clean 5/5 review and when its risk rating is at or below a ceiling you set (start with Low), with path/author/label filters, a per-repo .greptile policy read from the base branch, and support for GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket Cloud and Gitea (beta).

recommendations.name: cubic auto-approval
recommendations.description: cubic can submit GitHub approvals for clean PRs under a 'Low-risk only' policy, with a shadow mode to preview decisions first, never-approve and allowlist path rules, and configuration via the dashboard or cubic.yaml.

recommendations.name: Cursor PR Routing & Approval
recommendations.description: Cursor's approval agent approves low-risk PRs on GitHub based on a risk score cap, Bugbot/security findings and APPROVAL_POLICY.md files in your repo, and can also route PRs to the right reviewers.
